comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (60%) to As-CATH7 L=V=G=R: 13%. GRAVY: -0.15; Mol Wt: 2693.147; Mol formula: C122H201N36O31; mol ex Coeff: 7040. Activity: Active against E-faecium (MIC >64 uM), S. aureus (MIC 0.5 uM), K. pneumoniae (MIC 0.5 uM), A. baumannii (MIC 0.25 uM), P. aeruginosa (MIC 1 uM), E. cloacae (MIC 0.5 uM), E. coli (MIC 1 uM), S. Typhimurium (MIC 1 uM), and P. vulgaris (MIC 4 uM). Also inhibit biofilm formation. Organoid skin model: it eradicated S. aureus biofilms after 24 h treated at 200 ug. Animal model:mouse: it also showed an effect on skin infection. Structure: helical in SDS or DPC micelles. MOA:bacteria: It depolarizes and permeabilizes membranes, which may lead to DNA binding (DNA retardation assay). Updated ref 5/2023; 4/2025
title: Novel Alligator Cathelicidin As-CATH8 Demonstrates Anti-Infective Activity against Clinically Relevant and Crocodylian Bacterial Pathogens
